summary: The test suite is exceptionally well-crafted, covering both unit tests for the core PowerShell logic and end-to-end integration tests for the GitHub Actions workflow using `act`. It effectively covers all requirements, including the strict act testing and actionlint validation. It rigorously tests edge cases, boundary conditions (dates on the exact edge of the warning window), and handles invalid inputs gracefully. The design is highly readable and well-organized, using Pester optimally with BeforeAll setup blocks, informative descriptions, tags to separate fast from slow tests, and an elegant matrix execution strategy to test all fixtures efficiently within a single `act` run.
